thesis: This episode argues that Amazon and Google are critical beneficiaries of early cloud and mobile scale, while Tesla is positioned to disrupt utilities through residential solar and storage, potentially causing massive bankruptcies. Conversely, the speaker takes a bearish view on utilities like Occidental Petroleum, predicting that the shift to distributed energy will render hundreds of billions of dollars of utility debt worthless.
